title: docs(skills, spec): the ui and i18n skills teach an action's refusals catalogue and its translation keys; action.zod.ts gains a module description
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_
Fixes #34824
Clause-②: no — skill teaching text, evals and two comment-only edits in packages/spec; no schema, export or accept set moves
Metadata-protocol: none — no metadata key is touched
Tier: H — `check-governed-merges --branch` at b33d995a49: six `skills/**` paths govern the PR (the two generated `_index.md` rows no longer lift as pure regeneration, because the CI fix round edits a test under `packages/spec/scripts/`, the generator prefix that exception trusts). The low-risk skills arm does not fit this diff, which also carries `packages/spec` comments, a token-ceiling row and a changeset that releases `@objectstack/spec`
Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:已发布技能 `objectstack-ui` 的 `rules/actions.md` 新增一小节,教脚本动作怎样声明拒绝语目录 `refusals`、在动作体里只抛代码;`objectstack-i18n` 的对象键表新增一行,给出动作拒绝语的翻译键(`objects.OBJ._actions.ACT.refusals.CODE.message`、`.reasons.REASON.message`,无对象的动作写在 `globalActions.ACT` 下),并说明这句话按调用者语言回出。两个技能各加一条评测用例。另有两处只改注释的 spec 改动:`action.zod.ts` 加了模块说明(生成的参考页和两个技能索引行改为显示这句说明),`actionRefusalsWithoutSandboxedBody` 上方的注释改成与函数实际判断一致。
- 为什么改:PR #34719 已经让动作体可以按调用者的语言拒绝,但技能没有教。照技能写应用的 agent 仍会写 `throw new Error('英文句子')`,中文用户在失败提示里看到的还是英文。
- 风险与回滚:不动任何 schema、导出和运行时行为,spec 只改注释和一条测试钉子(CI 修复轮:`file-description.test.ts` 不再把 `action.zod.ts` 钉为无说明,改为正面钉住它的模块说明)。`rules/actions.md` 的 token 上限行由 2808 调到 2957:先删掉同文件 124 字节的重复(五处),余下 149 按实测上调。`objectstack-i18n` 的 SKILL.md 不动上限行:再删 63 字节重复后,与 main 合并的实测为 6327(上限 6333)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 中 `rules/actions.md` 那一行和它上方的注释(上限上调,风险最高);② `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` 的新小节 "Refusing by code (`refusals`)" 与 Add Line 示例里改动的两行;③ `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 键表末尾新增的一行。
- 两分钟验证:运行 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md is 2957 tokens (ceiling 2957; headroom 0)` 和 `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md is 6290 tokens (ceiling 6333; headroom 43)`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:审批本 PR(Tier H:改了 `skills/**`,并带 spec 注释和 token 上限行,不适用低风险 skills 通道);落地由席位完成。

## What changes

Placeholders are spelled as words in this body (`OBJ`, `ACT`, `CODE`, `REASON`, `HOOK`); the files keep their own placeholder spelling.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`** (the declaration)

- New subsection "Refusing by code (`refusals`)", under the action body context. It says: `throw new Error('…')` answers every caller in the author's language; a `type: 'script'` action with a `js` body declares `refusals` and throws the code (an inline `target` function is lowered to a `js` body, and any other action is refused the key); the catalogue, the throws and the checks are a hook's, taught in objectstack-data (Lifecycle Hooks, "Declared refusals") and only pointed at here; the sentence is answered as `userMessage` and translated at `objects.OBJ._actions.ACT.refusals.CODE.message`; the console's failure toast shows it unless the action authors `errorMessage`.
- The Add Line example declares `refusals: { PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: { message: 'Product not found.', status: 404 } }` and throws `{ code: 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND' }` where it threw `new Error('Product not found.')`. The block is `os:check`-marked, so `check:skill-examples` type-checks it.

**`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`** (the translation keys and the localized answer)

- Object key table, one new row: `_actions.{action_name}.refusals.{CODE}` holds `message`, and `reasons.{reason}.message` per declared reason; a key for a code or reason the action does not declare is `translation-target-unknown`; the same keys sit under `globalActions.{action_name}`.
- "Server-composed text" section, the app-authored bullet: an action's refusal is named beside a hook's. Both are served in the caller's locale, negotiated over the locales the app's translations hold, else as declared, with no `en` floor.

**Evals** (one case in each touched skill's existing file)

- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, case 20: a script action that refuses with an English `throw new Error(…)`; the prompt asks for a refusal in the caller's language with code `NOT_DRAFT` and a 409. Required: `refusals`, `NOT_DRAFT`, `409`, `_actions`. Forbidden: `hooks.submit_signoff`.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`, case 13: an action that declares two refusals, one with a reason and a `{{ stage }}` hole; the prompt asks which bundle keys translate them and what a locale no bundle covers gets. Required: `_actions`, `submit_signoff`, `refusals`, `NOT_DRAFT`, `reasons`, `closed`. Forbidden: `hooks.submit_signoff`.
- Every token is layout-free: a key or code name, never a spaced or quoted fragment, so an answer written as a dotted key and one written as a nested object both pass (probes under Tests).

**`packages/spec`, comments and one test pin**

- N4: `src/ui/action.zod.ts` opens with a module doc block. Its first line is "Action protocol schemas — `ActionSchema`, the `action` metadata type, and the parts it is built from."
- N5: the jsdoc above `actionRefusalsWithoutSandboxedBody` (`src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts`) names the third case as the function judges it: a `script` action with no `body`, which is what a string `target` naming a host handler, or an inline `target` function `os build` could not lower, leaves.
- CI fix round: `scripts/file-description.test.ts`. The #13334 corpus pin listed `ui/action.zod.ts` among eight modules that must print no description; N4 is the module header that pin left room for, so it went red (Test Core 2/10 on 85b26c86d4). The file leaves that list (now seven, unchanged otherwise), and a new case, "opens `ui/action` with the module header written above its imports (#34824 N4)", pins three facts: the opening exactly; only the licence line and blanks precede the block; the next non-blank line after it is an `import`. A symbol comment wedged back into the import list, or a header glued to a declaration, fails it.

**Generated, never hand-edited** (`check:generated --fix`, which ran `gen:skill-refs` and `gen:docs`)

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md` and `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md`: the `action.zod.ts` row prints the module description where it listed the first five exports. Since the CI fix round edits a test under `packages/spec/scripts/`, `check-governed-merges` no longer lifts them as pure regeneration (the generator prefix is co-edited) and counts them as governed; the tier is H either way. `check:skill-refs` reads them in sync.
- `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`: the page description and lead are the doc block.

**`.changeset/34824-action-refusals-skill.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch and `@objectstack/spec` patch, with both declaration lines.

### Token ratchet: cuts first, then the measured remainder

Raise path: the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068).

| File | Cut (same file) | Bytes | Text that still carries it |
|:--|:--|--:|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | The label line "**Script-typed action**:" above the Add to Campaign example, with its blank line | 26 | The block's own `type: 'script'` line, under the H2 "Examples" |
| same | The label "**Flow-typed action**" and the parentheses that held the `onSuccess` note. The note stays and now says "the flow run" | 19 | The block's own `type: 'flow'` line, right below the note |
| same | "`openIn: 'new-tab'` opens it in a new tab," in the paragraph under that H3. `'self'` is now spelled `openIn: 'self'` | 35 | The H3 "`openIn: 'new-tab'`" under the H2 "Opening in a New Tab", and the example's `openIn: 'new-tab'` line |
| same | " on success / failure" in the `successMessage` / `errorMessage` bullet | 21 | The two key names; the same bullet's "without `successMessage` the UI shows a generic "Action completed" toast"; the refusals paragraph's "the console's failure toast shows it unless the action authors `errorMessage`" |
| same | "(`{ field: 'email' }`)" beside "field-backed params" | 23 | The `{ field: … }` params in the Reassign Lead, Add to Campaign and Add Line examples |
| `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` | The path prefix in "Full Zod shape: `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` — …", now "(`translation.zod.ts`)" | 44 | The full path in "Authoring at Runtime: the `translation` Item" of the same file (it survives the merge with main), and `references/_index.md` |
| same | The hook reason key's repeated prefix `hooks.HOOK.refusals`, now `….CODE.reasons.REASON.message` | 18 | The full hook key earlier in the same sentence |
| same | In "Shipped examples": "one `crm.translation.ts`, " on the `app-crm` line and "(`{en,zh-CN,ja-JP}.ts` + `index.ts`)" on the `app-todo` line | 63 | The Files column of the File Organization table: "one `crm.translation.ts` holding every locale" (Bundled) and "`src/translations/{en,zh-CN,ja-JP}.ts` + `index.ts`" (Per-locale). Each line keeps its layout name, and the `app-crm` line keeps its locales |

- `rules/actions.md` had zero headroom. The text adds 721 bytes and the five cuts remove 124: 11231 to 11828 bytes, `ceil(11828 / 4)` = 2957. The row moves 2808 to 2957 (+149), the measured remainder, pinned at the measurement. The first cut landed with the teaching (row 2982, +174); a fold round before L1 found the other four (98 bytes) and the row followed the measurement down by 25.
- Read and kept in `rules/actions.md`, each the only statement of its point in a file this skill ships: the organization read `ctx.user?.organizationId ?? ctx.session?.organizationId` (objectstack-data's hook reference has the same line, but an action author holding the ui skill alone needs the spelling), the "Set `refreshAfter: true`" callout, the "not in `description`" sentence on `disabledReason`, and the new-tab `params` callout.
- `objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` needs no row move. Alone it goes 6219 to 6290 tokens against the ceiling 6333: the table row adds 322 bytes, the bullet a net 68 after its 18-byte key cut, and the other two cuts remove 44 and 63: 24894 to 25177 bytes.
- Merged with `origin/main` (b85dff0f43, which holds #35031 and its +148 bytes in this file) the i18n file is 25325 bytes, 6327 tokens, headroom 6. That is the gate's own line, run on the `git merge-tree` result. Before the 63-byte cut the same merge read 6342, over the row by 9: the red `Type Check · source gates` reported on ce9156c34c, whose run is on the merge with main. The later lander pays that row, and that is this PR.

The bundle moves +943 tokens: +149 in `rules/actions.md`, +71 in the i18n SKILL.md, +324 and +397 in the two eval fixtures (measured, not priced) and +1 in each generated index.

## Tests

- No runtime behaviour changes and the spec source edits are comments, so there is no new behaviour test and no ablation. The CI fix round changes one corpus pin (What changes); only the test changed, nothing it tests.
- CI fix round, red then green: `vitest run --project repo scripts/file-description.test.ts` at 85b26c86d4: `Tests 1 failed | 110 passed (111)`, `ui/action.zod.ts: expected 'Action protocol schemas — …' to be null`; at b33d995a49: `Tests 112 passed (112)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` at b33d995a49: `Test Files 91 passed (91)`, `Tests 1558 passed (1558)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Eval assertions, by script over both files (12 and 20 cases): every `must_contain` string is in its `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` string is, the ids are distinct. 0 violations. Control leg: a copy with an absent required token, a present forbidden token and a duplicated id reports all three and exits 1.
- The two new cases against six probe answers, graded by the runner's own `gradeAnswer` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts`): a right answer written as code across lines with a nested bundle object passes each case; a locale branch in the body, the hook key, and a `messages` entry each fail. 6 of 6 as expected.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --dry-run`: exit 0, the catalog loads with no refusal (`objectstack-i18n: 19 case(s)`, `objectstack-ui: 40 case(s)`). `--self-test`: `30 rows pass`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` under the verify lock, at 2a2e7d6660: `Test Files 852 passed (852)`, `Tests 27264 passed | 1 todo (27265)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **The i18n token row is shared.** #35031 has merged, and the payment it left for the later lander is made here (token section above): merged with `origin/main` the file reads 6327 of 6333. The open draft #34970 (8f62dd835c) adds 63 more tokens: with main and this branch it reads 6390, a clean textual merge. It lands later and re-pays the row there, as the claim says. Three more same-file restatements were seen and left for that payment, not spent here: "Configure i18n settings in your `objectstack.config.ts`:" under "Stack-Level I18n Config", ", assembled by your own imports" in the Per-namespace row, and ", one locale per item" in the runtime-item paragraph.
- **Two open drafts conflict with it textually** (`overlap-check` exit 1 at 85b26c86d4). #35077 (7fe6fb7ade) rewrites the same `rules/actions.md` row in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`; the skill file itself merges cleanly (the four new cuts touch none of its lines), and the merged file measures 12720 bytes, 3180 tokens, which is the number the second lander pins. #35085 (7d7241a893) regenerates `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`; the second lander re-runs `check:generated --fix`. Its edits to `action.zod.ts` and `hook-refusal-codes.ts` merge cleanly with the two comments here. The seat ordered #35077 and #35085 to land first; this PR merges main after them.
- The i18n eval case is numbered 13 and sits before case 10, so its hunk stays apart from #35031's case 12 at the end of the list.
- The objectstack-ui `SKILL.md` router line for `rules/actions.md` does not name `refusals`. That file has zero headroom and is outside this card's file surface. Noted, not filed.
- The teaching points at objectstack-data's "Declared refusals" for the entry shape (`status`, `params`, `reasons`) and does not restate it. An agent holding the ui bundle alone gets the declaration, the throw and the key from the subsection and the example.
- `origin/main` was merged twice while this work ran (357fb1ea45, then 1282a464e9, which carries the eval reader of #35022). No conflict either time; the generated files were not touched by either merge. The fold round (85b26c86d4) did not merge main, by the seat's order.

## Verification

<details><summary>Premise, re-measured on origin/main</summary>

- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` ("Refuse in the user's language — `refusals`") and `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` (the "Action refusal messages" row) document what the skills now teach.
- One resolver answers a hook's and an action's catalogue (`resolveSandboxedRefusal`, `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`), so "the catalogue, the throws and the checks are a hook's" holds.
- `checkActionRefusals` (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`) reports `translation-target-unknown` for an undeclared code and for an undeclared reason.
- The console shows an authored `errorMessage` first, then the refusal's `userMessage` (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`).
- `refuseUndeclaredLiteralActionRefusalCode` (`action.zod.ts`) calls `actionRefusalsWithoutSandboxedBody` when the type is not `script` or `body.language` is not `js`; with no body the language is undefined, the third arm of the sentence.
</details>
